note: A prediction's value is frozen at registration. If the source artifact later reports a different value, the check fails with PREDICTION DRIFT: register a new prediction and mark this one superseded. Never edit a registered value.

predictions.quantity: delay from deploy trigger call to GPIO 33 rising edge
predictions.condition: rocket firmware as committed; inert bench; no load on GPIO 33
predictions.basis: Requested delay in firmware. This is a setpoint, not a model of achieved timing.
predictions.measurement_method: External logic analyzer on GPIO 33 and a trigger-reference GPIO; see P-001.

predictions.quantity: dry centre of gravity from nose tip
predictions.condition: OpenRocket override masses of the body tubes only; no motor
predictions.basis: Reference script's aggregation of body-tube override masses (excludes the nose-cone override mass; D-008).
predictions.measurement_method: Balance point of the assembled inert airframe, fins deployed, motor mount empty.

predictions.quantity: torsion spring rate of the supplied spring
predictions.condition: spring as supplied, room temperature, within its rated angle
predictions.basis: Value stated in the source paper; no datasheet or measurement is recorded.

predictions.quantity: fraction of deployments that reach and hold the lock position
predictions.condition: simulated tolerance ranges of the C7 run record
predictions.basis: Simulation whose velocity criterion cannot fail for a locked trial (D-013).
predictions.measurement_method: Repeated inert spring deployments of a printed mechanism; requires C1 to be resolved first.

predictions.quantity: interval between successive rocket DATA packets
predictions.condition: rocket firmware as committed, MPU6050 healthy
predictions.basis: Firmware send period. Live T packets are stamped with launcher relay time, so their spacing measures relay cadence (D-018).
predictions.measurement_method: LOG-stream intervals from an onboard log dump (rocket clock), audited with python -m evidence audit.
